items.source: Properties in form key=value that should be added to the Spring Environment before the test runs.
items.translation: 要在测试运行之前添加到 Spring Environment 的 form key=value 格式的属性。

items.source: Specifies the controllers to test.
items.translation: 指定要测试的控制器。

items.source: Auto-configuration exclusions that should be applied for this test.
items.translation: 应应用于此测试的自动配置排除项。

items.source:
A set of exclude filters which can be used to filter beans that would otherwise be
added to the application context.
items.translation: 一组排除过滤器，可用于过滤本应添加到应用上下文的 Bean。

items.source:
A set of include filters which can be used to add otherwise filtered beans to the
application context.
items.translation: 一组包含过滤器，可用于将其他过滤器排除的 bean 添加到应用程序上下文中。

items.source: the controllers to test
items.translation: 要测试的控制器

items.source: Typically @GraphQlTest is used in combination with @MockitoBean or @Import to load any collaborators and other components required for the tests.
items.translation: 通常，@GraphQlTest 与 @MockitoBean 或 @Import 结合使用，以加载测试所需的任何协作对象和其他组件。

items.source: To load your full application configuration instead and test via HttpGraphQlTester, consider using @SpringBootTest combined with @AutoConfigureHttpGraphQlTester.
items.translation: 若要加载完整的应用程序配置并通过HttpGraphQlTester进行测试，请考虑使用@SpringBootTest与@AutoConfigureHttpGraphQlTester相结合。

items.source: By default, tests annotated with @GraphQlTest have a GraphQlTester configured. For more fine-grained control of the GraphQlTester, use @AutoConfigureGraphQlTester.
items.translation: 默认情况下，带有 @GraphQlTest 注解的测试已配置了 GraphQlTester。如需对 GraphQlTester 进行更精细的控制，请使用@AutoConfigureGraphQlTester。

items.source: The annotation does not automatically load @Component, @Service, @Repository, and other beans.
items.translation: 该注解不会自动加载 @Component`、@Service` 和其他 Bean。

items.source:
The annotation disables full auto-configuration and instead loads only components
relevant to GraphQL tests, including the following:
items.translation: 该注解会禁用完整的自动配置，转而仅加载与 GraphQL 测试相关的组件，包括以下内容：

items.source: Determines if default filtering should be used with @SpringBootApplication. By default, only @Controller (when no explicit controllers are defined), RuntimeWiringConfigurer, @JacksonComponent, @JsonComponent (deprecated), Converter, GenericConverter, DataFetcherExceptionResolver, Instrumentation and GraphQlSourceBuilderCustomizer beans are included.
items.translation: 确定是否应使用默认过滤功能与@SpringBootApplication。默认情况下，仅包含@Controller（当未显式定义controllers时）、RuntimeWiringConfigurer、@JacksonComponent、@JsonComponent（已弃用）、Converter、GenericConverter、DataFetcherExceptionResolver、Instrumentation和GraphQlSourceBuilderCustomizerbean。

items.source: Specifies the controllers to test. This is an alias of controllers() which can be used for brevity if no other attributes are defined. See controllers() for details.
items.translation: 指定要测试的控制器。这是 controllers() 的别名，如果未定义其他属性，可用于简化代码。有关详细信息，请参阅 controllers()。

items.source: Specifies the controllers to test. May be left blank if all @Controller beans should be added to the application context.
items.translation: 指定要测试的控制器。如果希望将所有 @Controller` Bean 添加到应用程序上下文中，可以留空。

items.source: Determines if default filtering should be used with @SpringBootApplication.
items.translation: 确定是否应使用默认过滤功能配合 @SpringBootApplication。
